title: The man that got away James Stephens.
html_source:
In the middle of Joe’s hyperbolic lauding of the Citizen, he gives him credit for a famous event in Fenian circles. James Stephens was the head of the organization that would eventually become the Irish Republican Brotherhood, and he was arrested in 1865. In just the matter of a fortnight he escaped prison, supposedly with assistance, and fled to France.

In Calypso, Bloom mentions the same aphorism about “the boxpay man at the bathhouse”.
